Dhaka, Oct 4 (UNI) Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Tuesday urged the countrymen to abstain from saying anything hurtful to religious sentiments and magnifying any incident that goes against any religion, rather look at the punitive measures taken by the government.

"None can hurt the religious sentiments of any religion. None can say anything hurtful to the religious sentiments. It is applicable to any religion. Because it is one's faith, one's faith in God," she said.
